summary: Core AI Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: CHAI) filed a Form 6-K on July 21, 2026, announcing the strategic repositioning of HomeGPT as an AI-powered residential decision layer, enhancing home design and renovation tools. The filing contains a press release with forward-looking statements but includes no specific transaction, terms, prices, or shareholder vote. The registrant is a Canadian foreign private issuer, and the Form 6-K is a routine update on corporate strategy. There are no deal terms, advisory roles, or structural mechanics disclosed. This is not a special-situation event; it is an ordinary product/strategy announcement with no M&A, capital action, or governance change.
